notes: Part 3: section 6, questions 37-50, 52, 53, 54, 56, 57 of the NIST CFReDS Data Leakage answer key (2018-07-23). Worked from the answer key text and PDF and the row vocabulary only. 'page' is the PDF page (the '===== PAGE n =====' marker), as in eval/reference.json. TIME ZONES: Q37, Q44, Q45, Q46, Q47, Q48, Q52 carry the caption '(Timezone is applied)' = local time, US Eastern Daylight Time on these dates, utc = printed + 4 h. Q41 has no caption; read as local time (section 3 timeline). Q49 prints its own offsets: created times '(UTC-04)', modified times '(UTC-05)' (January), converted accordingly. Q52 Google Drive log lines print '-0400'; milliseconds dropped. Q38, Q39, Q40, Q42, Q43, Q50, Q53, Q54, Q56, Q57 print no times. GRANULARITY: one item per answer entity (a table row, an e-mail, a database record, a listed file), split per timestamp where a kind exists for that timestamp; attribute cells (size, format, checksum, body text, attachment) are quoted in 'nist' but are not separate items, as in Q21/Q55 of the existing reference. 'Considerations' blocks are not transcribed, except (a) values needed to fill a matcher of an answer row (Q47 shadow copy id) and (b) the Eraser rename chain that the Q52 wiping row points to with '(See below)' (Q52-34..41, marked in their notes). KIND CHOICES: file locations (Q38, Q40, Q42, Q47) are fileCreated with no time, as Q55 in the existing reference. Q44 rows are webVisit (URL exact, browser Internet Explorer); Q45 rows are emailSent with subject and time only, as Q21 in the existing reference (from/to are printed but not matched). Q46 rows are fileSeen / 'windows search index' with the printed Date Created; paths are printed with doubled backslashes, read as single separators. Q48 table rows are fileCreated and fileModified of the files inside the shadow copy; 'exists in VSC' sentences are fileSeen / 'shadow copy'. Q49: the deleted record is cloudFile 'google drive: deleted' (no time), its columns cloudFile created / modified. Q52: Search = webSearch, Download = fileDownloaded with the URL as source, Install/Run/Uninstall = programRun (executable name; printed path not matched), wiped files = fileDeleted on the day (a time range is printed), Shift+Delete and Google Drive 'Deleting file' = fileDeleted. Q52 rows 1, 2, 4 repeat Q16; Q45 repeats most of Q21. Q53 = fileCreated on RM#2 with aux containing 'unallocated space' (Q54: the old directory entries lie in unallocated areas). NOT TRANSCRIBED: Q58-Q60 lie in the line range given for Q57 but are not in this part's question list.
